candidate: Character construction consumes a current-line letter/other character through the existing FileInput::read_character only when the token-source stack is empty; the generic reader handles every other condition.
build: cargo build --release --bin umber --lib; ordinary default features, no extra rustflags
order: serial alternating pairs; attribution run separately
scope: Complete ordinary CLI on the unchanged three 600-paragraph layout inputs and existing authentic Gentle mixed input. Short shared-host measurements; modest gains do not establish general TeX/LaTeX performance.

release_path_attribution.llvm_eliminates: Raw origin coordinates and unused aggregate fields; direct candidate also eliminates token packing before byte extraction. Generic reader call/prologue, category dispatch, name-capacity check, token decoding, expansion tests and final command classification survive on the original path.
release_path_attribution.caution: Inline source attribution is not a complete function/phase total. Whole-CLI totals and call arcs are measured directly.

invariants: Direct read is attempted only with an empty token-source stack; pending, backed, inline, replacement-body and argument sources therefore retain priority and generic ownership/retirement. Existing operation accepts only current category 11/12 in the already-prepared line, consumes exactly one reported byte and sets lexical state M. Every miss is unread and uses the existing reader, including line load/EOF, ^^, active/control characters, invalid bytes, comments and ignored bytes. No pretokenization or persistent cache/state. Space-factor, missing-character, node/ligature processing, budget and checkpoint paths are unchanged.
validation: 169 ordinary tests and all 3 native oracle adapters pass; rustfmt and Clippy with warnings denied pass. Three focused tests cover dynamic/group-restored categories, committed ^^ rewrites, active characters, comments and line state, changed endlinechar, character aliases, chardef, nested argument/empty-macro boundaries, frozen categories in stored tokens, missing glyph consumption/space factor, invalid-character consumption and EOF. Complete output/font records and retained-root replay equal on all four workloads; native DVI placements equal on all three originals and 214800 glyph/rule records over 106 mixed pages.
measured_candidate: Isolated prototype; integrated runtime source and focused tests are byte-identical. Binary hashes identify the timed prototype and baseline; build paths differ from integration.
reproduction: Preserve target/benchmark/layout/{book,narrow,dense}.tex unchanged; regenerating from edited docs changes the inputs. Use the existing mixed Gentle source and AE font resources identified by layout-metric-reader.json. Build default-feature release CLI, save before/after binaries, and use benchmarks/layout.py child CPU/wall accounting with one warmup and nine serial alternating pairs on CPU3. Run Callgrind separately from ordinary timing.
integration_validation: Runtime source and focused tests are byte-identical to the validated prototype. All three focused semantic tests, rustfmt, Clippy with warnings denied, ordinary default release CLI/library/layout-example rebuild, wasm32-unknown-unknown library check, source identity and mixed CLI output comparison pass. No further timing sweep.
